notes: Scores are S3PL's own in-job mSCF1 (metrics.json), recomputed unrounded; not the fair-scoring evaluator. Published values are given to 2 decimals.
Saved released runs are reused after gate 72136 (bit-identical to job 53121).
The percentile of a published value is the share of our seeds strictly below it, with ties counted as one half.
B2 uses the exact expectation of the maximum over a uniformly random k-subset of the 10 seeds, per section, then the mean over sections.
Investigation 21 GPU jobs were not exclusive (bigbatch has no GPU gres); runtimes are descriptive.

A run may hold fewer than num_GT_peaks peaks only if that equals its logged distinct-selection count (released code, test.py:167-184; chat 2026-10-20 20:39); such runs are kept, so the 8 x 10 design stays balanced, and are listed in short_peak_lists.
